stations.title: Coroner & Substance Reports
stations.conclusion: Coroner: alcohol + cocaine in the victim's system. Estimated time of death between 22:00 and 00:00. Substance analysis: real cocaine traces on the table, but the brick on the counter is FAKE cocaine (unknown adulterant).

stations.title: Fingerprint Analysis
stations.conclusion: Prints lifted from the dining table, kitchen chair and teapot. The tea-table chair was wiped clean. Without DNA matches we cannot yet attribute prints, but the wiped chair is suspicious.

stations.title: Fiber Analysis
stations.conclusion: The fiber on the fallen button matches the fiber caught on the broken branch outside. The button fiber could not be matched to any jacket recovered on scene.

stations.title: DNA Comparison
stations.conclusion: Samples 1+2 match: the victim. Samples 3+4 match: the person who lost the shirt button ALSO hid the broken teacup outside. Sample 5: a third person who slept in the bed upstairs and is unlikely to have hidden the glass.

stations.title: Cellular & Network Data
stations.conclusion: Cell map and text printouts show that Karim attempted to remotely wipe the victim's phone via Google. The Faraday cage prevented the deletion and preserved the evidence.

stations.title: Light Wavelength / Spectrum
stations.conclusion: Under UV, the cocaine brick reveals a hidden mark linked to Karim. The victim's body shows internal bruising on the fingertips, consistent with a struggle.
